text: Priestesses and Knights at once, the high-ranking officers of the Order of the Eagle are expert fighters and unrivalled tacticians.

Duellists, also known as Diestros in Estalia, are agents, swashbucklers and rascals who'd produce their rapiers at the drop of a penny. Among the best of them, swordsmanship is as legendary as their boasts!
Mercenary captains are usually found leading companies of local troops or mercenaries, generally trying to make sure they get paid and not maimed too much.
Mercenary generals are powerful individuals of various origins, from Princes to former soldiers, with the wealth and usually the know-how to employ armies of militias and mercenaries.
